content.title: PROBLEM ----- {{FOOD}} FIX YOU'VE NEVER TRIED
facts: **Brain fog** ----- Blueberries (1 cup/day boosts blood flow to the brain)
**Bloating** ----- Fennel Seeds (chew 1 tsp after meals to ease trapped gas)
**Bad breath** ----- Parsley (a few sprigs neutralize sulfur compounds fast)
**Muscle cramps** ----- Bananas (1 daily replenishes potassium you sweat out)
**Headaches** ----- Watermelon (2 cups fights the dehydration behind them)
**Restless legs** ----- Chickpeas (1/2 cup/day for iron your muscles need)
**Acne breakouts** ----- Green Tea (2 cups/day calms skin inflammation)
**Constant hiccups** ----- Peanut Butter (1 spoonful resets your diaphragm)
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Ever notice how a little **blueberries** habit can clear that foggy, sluggish feeling in your head? It's not magic — the antioxidants in them actually improve circulation to your brain, so more oxygen gets where it needs to go. Dealing with **bloating** after meals? Fennel seeds contain compounds that relax the muscles in your gut lining, which is why chewing on them can quiet things down within minutes. And if you're one of those people who gets random muscle cramps, especially at night, it's usually your body quietly begging for potassium — which is exactly why bananas work so well as a simple fix. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what actually helps you.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organ function, and small daily habits into things you can actually use. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes that don't last.
